race.comment: Tough. PARVATI PARTY (7) was a solid winner here over 2125m two starts ago before measuring up well to stronger company at Flemington, beaten a neck over 2800m in a slowly run race. This looks a nice spot for her for the in-form yard. DURBAN HARBOUR (5) has placed in his past couple, beaten a head in a bunched finish here last time out. Up to 2400m now should suit and he'll take holding out. EMPRESS OF THE SUN (6) is consistent around this level, close up in stronger company last time. Drawn wide but Johnstone can roll forward and give a sight. CUSTOMER SERVICE (4) did beat home EMPRESS OF THE SUN when they met and will go close again.
